text: Looking after my grandson tonight, he's 2. Two things and I'd like a straight answer if possible. First, he's got a temperature, 38.9 on the ear thermometer, I think it's accurate but I'm not certain how reliable those things are. Second, about teatime he banged his head on the edge of the kitchen table, he cried straight away, loud, and within a few minutes he was back to normal and he's been perfectly himself since, running about. I don't think the two are connected but I'm not entirely sure, which is why I'm asking. There's no rash on him as far as I can see, I've checked him all over, and his nappies are wet as usual so I'm fairly confident he's drinking enough. Do I need to take him anywhere tonight or can it wait for his parents to get back in the morning
